contract.title: TWIN-56 MC/TH串口调试日志[MC-DBG]/[TH-DBG] 16-bit seq截断修复与MC本地级联号段隔离
contract.accepted_scope: C unit-test verification in Docker QA sandbox (gcc) of MC (AT32F435) and TH (AT32F423) 16-bit sequence number logging in [MC-DBG] (minimc_proto.h/c) and [TH-DBG] (usart.c), MC local cascade initial sequence offset s_mc_th_seq = 0x0100U in minimc_proto_init(), and debug_reconciliation_probe.py --self-test compatibility. Cross-compiler ELF build and physical MCU USB/UART HIL are not applicable in qa-sandbox:20261029 (host arm-none-eabi-gcc build is verified in author_01 and physical HIL in TWIN-55): qa-sandbox:20261029 provides host GCC/Python only and no physical MCU hardware; all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.

dependency_conditions.required: 继承TWIN-47 MC端控制命令结构与[MC-DBG]日志基线
继承TWIN-48 TH端级联控制与[TH-DBG]日志基线

commands.expected: 容器/宿主gcc编译minimc_proto.c、test_twin44_mc_debug.c、usart.c、test_twin45_th_debug.c 0错误；验证MC本地minimc_proto_send_th_gcode首帧seq=257(0x0101U)及AP请求seq>255(如seq=301)在[MC-DBG]与[TH-DBG]中原样输出16-bit完整十进制数值无8-bit截断；全部正反例与debug_reconciliation_probe.py --self-test 100% PASS

positive_cases: MC minimc_proto.c与TH usart.c将[MC-DBG]/[TH-DBG]中的seq、ack_seq、last_seq、s_relay_seq升位为uint16_t，完整提取frame[8] | (frame[9] << 8U)，seq > 255原样输出无模256截断
minimc_proto_init()恢复s_mc_th_seq = 0x0100U，使MC本地发起的0x1C级联G-code帧从seq=257(0x0101U)起步，与AP序列号清晰区分
negative_cases: 收到高位16-bit seq(>255)的CRC错误帧或未知命令帧时，输出[MC-DBG]/[TH-DBG] ERR或NACK日志且其中的16-bit seq保持完整无截断，后续合法帧立即恢复
调试环形缓冲满时非阻塞拒绝写入并累加丢包计数，排空后恢复正常16-bit seq输出
